notes: Fictional subject insert (made-up subject, real relation and object) (TBox): a made-up class under a real one. Determinate: a new member named in the prompt (inheritance) and the class's place under 'meets another plate' (transitivity of subclass_of). Indeterminate (background beliefs): the real thing touched is the textbook list of three plate-boundary types. The edit does not say whether varnic boundaries are a new type or a kind of an existing one, so a model that holds the list as closed (w1) and one that counts the kinds it holds (w2) both stay consistent with the edit. Near query: the San Andreas Fault's boundary type (transform), not the new answer. 'Orrin Line' is a made-up member name.
